legal.notes: Five references properly cited with working URLs. NHTSA Part 573 filing (26V423) is primary source. FMVSS 111 mandate date (May 2018) verified. rigor.notes: Novel contribution: cross-referencing FMVSS 111 mandate timeline with recall failure timeline to show first-generation legally mandated cameras were defective by design, plus Magna supplier abandonment as untold dimension. Limitations in disclaimer. Counterargument could be stronger — 0.8% estimated defect rate suggests vast majority unaffected. Minor weakness: causal link between camera failure and FARS deaths acknowledged as circumstantial. Strongest counterargument: Honda may have been waiting for conclusive root cause analysis before expanding, which is responsible engineering practice.
